contents.name: Host
contents.description: The Modbus TCP device IP address or hostname (eg. "10.0.0.5").

contents.name: Port
contents.description: The Modbus TCP port (eg. 502, the Modbus default).

contents.name: UnitIdentifier
contents.description: The Modbus unit identifier (0-255) of the target device. Conventionally 255 for a directly addressed Modbus TCP device; meaningful when the TCP endpoint is a gateway bridging to serial units.

contents.name: PollingInterval
contents.description: The cyclic poll interval for reading all configured streams (eg. "PT1S" for 1 second). Modbus TCP has no server-initiated notifications, so the source must poll for values.

contents.name: Streams
contents.description: Contains all Modbus streams of the given source.

contents.name: Health
contents.description: Health message with Modbus source specific health information.
